subject: Verdant AI — request: onboarding credits + short pilot extension
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@verdant-ai.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@verdant-ai.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-08T09:12:00Z
Subject: Verdant AI — request: onboarding credits + short pilot extension

Hi Samir / Lena,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — great product fit on the inference side and impressive latency testing. As discussed, I'd like to propose a one-time onboarding package to help Verdant accelerate the pilot and prove the integration ROI: 

- 50,000 token credit applied to the pilot usage (one-time)
- 3-week trial extension (total pilot length: 7 weeks)
- Access to a dedicated CSM for setup and two onboarding sessions

I've attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines milestones and expected usage. The credit is conditional on a minimum intro commit (12-month, 25k/mo usage) if we see the expected performance during the pilot.

Attachments: Verdant-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Next steps: if this looks sensible to you, confirm and I'll loop in finance/legal for the paperwork and request an exec exception for the credit + extension.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Samir Patel <samir@verdant-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@verdant-ai.com>
Date: 2027-12-09T14:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Verdant AI — request: onboarding credits + short pilot extension

Marissa — thanks for the proposal. The MAP looks good and the dedicated CSM is a big plus. One ask from our side: to make it executable internally, we need a slightly larger credit buffer and a longer runway to hit the performance metrics. Can you do:

- 100,000 token credit (one-time)
- 8-week pilot total (i.e., 4-week extension instead of 3)
- A 10% first-year usage discount if we convert to the 12-month commit within 30 days of pilot close

If you can get any of those terms approved it will remove the internal financial hold and let us sign quickly.

—Samir
VP Product, Verdant AI
samir@verdant-ai.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-09T15:02:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Verdant AI — request: onboarding credits + short pilot extension

Ben / Aditya — forwarding Verdant's counter. They asked for more runway & credit: 100k tokens + 4-week extension and a 10% first-year usage discount if they convert within 30 days. Business case in short:

- Verdant is a mid-market AI platform (Series B) with a clear path to immediate $$/mo if pilot succeeds; CSM says integration should be quick.
- The budget hold is small; the exec team will sign if we provide the extra cushion.

Attachments: Verdant-MAP-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Can we get an exception here? If approved, I'll send revised MAP + DocuSign and request legal to expedite.

Thanks,
Marissa
(On Thu, Dec 9, 2027 at 2:37 PM Samir Patel <samir@verdant-ai.com> wrote:)
> Marissa — thanks for the proposal...
> [external message quoted above]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-10T08:55:00Z
Subject: RE: Verdant AI — request: onboarding credits + short pilot extension

Marissa — thanks for the context. Given the conversion signal and the fact this is a relatively low-dollar pilot, I'm comfortable approving a one-time exception with the following limits: 

- Approve 75,000 token onboarding credit (one-time)
- Approve a 6-week total pilot (i.e., 3-week extension)
- Approve a 5% first-year usage discount (if they convert to the 12-month commit within 30 days)

Conditions: Legal must sign off on the amendment language, and the CSM (Grace) will be assigned to own milestone delivery. We should track the MAP milestones in HubSpot and require a mutual check-in at week 3 to evaluate.

If this is acceptable, Marissa please update the MAP and send the DocuSign request citing deal VDNT-2027-311. Finance will apply the credit in billing once the amendment is countersigned.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@verdant-ai.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@verdant-ai.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-10T09:20:00Z
Subject: Verdant AI — approved onboarding concession and next steps

Samir / Lena — good news: leadership has approved a revised package to get you over the finish line. Approved terms (one-time concession):

- 75,000 token onboarding credit applied to pilot billing
- Pilot extension: 3 additional weeks (total 7 weeks)
- 5% first-year usage discount if Verdant signs the 12-month commit within 30 days of pilot close

Next steps: I've updated the MAP and initiated a DocuSign amendment for signatures (link below). Grace (cc'd) will kick off the onboarding plan and schedule the first session. Once countersigned, finance will apply the credit to the pilot invoice.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/verdant-pilot-agreement
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/VDNT-2027-311

Please reply here to confirm you accept these terms and we'll get legal to countersign.

Thanks!
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
